verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical. Each splits the design into a flat opaque teal panel holding the quote frame and a separate untinted photo panel, which loses the original's teal-tinted photo with the quote laid over it. Both also have wide white gutters and margins, a thin frame squeezed into the middle of the teal panel, a tiny unreadable rule line under the quote, and quote marks and icons that look accidentally clipped at the panel edges.
